title: Staff DevOps Engineer
description:
**Staff DevOps Engineer** 




**Hamburg – Permanent Employee, Full\-Time, Hybrid (Monday \& Friday remote)** 




**€80,000 \- €100,000 \+ Holiday \+ Flexible working hours** 




  





 Excellent opportunity for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join an innovative start\-up that is using data and AI to optimise the product planning and scheduling solutions for process manufacturing.
 



  





 This company uses technology and real\-time data to create a planning system that increases client’s profitability and efficiency. Their goal is to build the leading planning solution in process manufacturing, using data as a driving force.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will be an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer who has designed CI/CD pipelines to support the entire code lifestyle. You will have had hands\-on experience with scripting as well as managing logging and observability systems.
 



  





 This is a fantastic opportunity to join a company in an exciting period of growth where your expertise will contribute to the
 
 evolution of data strategy.
 



  





**The role:** 



* Own pipelines to connect development to production
* Designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
* Manage the company’s monitoring, logging and alerting systems
* Evaluate and evolve the architecture tools
* Hybrid working
* Fluent English



  





**The Person:** 



* Experience with the design and operation of CI/CD pipelines as well as its implementation in the lifecycle of code (GitHub Actions, Ansible, Terraform)
* Proficiency in the management of logging and observability systems (Fluentd, Grafana, Loki)
* Excellent scripting skills (Python, PowerShell, Bash)
* Strong knowledge with Docker and Linuxbased environments
* Understanding of network fundamentals (DNS, ports, firewalls, TCP/IP)



  





 For all other roles, please connect with me at: linkedin.com/in/abigail\-francesca\-lawrence
 



  





*Reference Number: 264742* 




  





*To apply for this role or to be considered for further roles, please click "Apply Now" or contact Abigail Lawrence at Rise Technical Recruitment.* 




  





*Rise Technical Recruitment GmbH acts an employment agency for permanent roles and an employment business for temporary roles.* 




  





*The salary advertised is the bracket available for this position. The actual salary paid will be dependent on your level of experience, qualifications and skill set. We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitable candidates.*
